64234-miss-tweedham-s-elogarsn:
Robert Moore Williams's Miss Tweedham's Elogarsn ran in Planet Stories in September 1953. The head note gives her choice in the tale's own strange words: a thlat and freedom, or Malovel and his esse. She chose the latter, dangerous as it was, and with them came Sanderson, man among men on this desert star.

Mars is the ground. L'Sor, a Martian, taunts the newcomer Ed Early: you humans are too soft to stay alive here, and Malovel will hold you in the hollow of his hands. John Sanderson, boss of Sandersonville, watches in silence to learn what metal Early is made of. Miss Tweedham, a big woman tired of her work, has come to Mars to find what her life was missing.
